title: SIGMA: speaker-isolated, symptom-structured multimodal estimation of depression severity from clinical interviews
abstract: arXiv:2611.23348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinical interviews are central to depression assessment but time-consuming and rater-dependent. Automated severity estimation offers scalable screening, yet existing methods often retain interviewer speech (confounding participant cues), fuse modalities late (losing fine-grained cross-modal dynamics), or score symptoms independently (ignoring inter-symptom correlations). We present SIGMA, a speaker-aware, symptom-structured framework for depression-severity estimation from semi-clinical interviews. SIGMA uses speaker diarization to restrict input to participant speech, cross-attention so that text, audio and video condition one another during encoding, and a graded-response head that predicts the eight questionnaire items jointly through a shared latent severity trait with item-specific ordered thresholds. translated_title: SIGMA：基于说话人分离、症状结构化的临床访谈抑郁严重程度多模态估计
translated_abstract: 临床访谈是抑郁症评估的核心手段，但耗时且依赖于评分者。自动化严重程度评估提供了可扩展的筛查能力，然而现有方法往往保留了访谈者的语音（混淆了参与者的线索）、在后期才融合各模态（丢失了细粒度的跨模态动态），或独立地对症状进行评分（忽略了症状间的相关性）。我们提出了SIGMA，这是一个具有说话人感知能力、症状结构化的半临床访谈抑郁严重程度估计框架。SIGMA使用说话人分离技术将输入限制为参与者的语音，采用交叉注意力机制使文本、音频和视频在编码过程中相互调制，并使用分级响应头通过共享的潜在严重程度特质和针对每个条目的有序阈值，联合预测八个问卷条目。在扩展痛苦分析访谈语料库上，SIGMA取得了最先进的性能（CCC 0.762，RMSE 4.13，MAE 3.30）
tldr: SIGMA框架通过说话人分离、跨模态交叉注意力编码以及基于共享潜在严重程度特质的症状联合预测，在临床访谈中实现了抑郁严重程度的最先进多模态估计。
en_tdlr: SIGMA achieves state-of-the-art depression severity estimation from clinical interviews by isolating participant speech via diarization, using cross-attention fusion of text, audio and video, and jointly predicting questionnaire items through a shared latent severity trait.
